description: Check whether the ownership proof for a host is published (well-known file over HTTPS, then DNS TXT record) and matches the configured secret. Use it after the user says they published the proof from ownership_proof, before calling scan. Fetches one file and resolves one DNS record; changes nothing. Returns Verified or Not verified with the reason (missing, mismatch, unreachable).

host.description: Bare host name of the MCP server, without scheme, port or path: mcp.example.com, not https://mcp.example.com/mcp. Use the host of the URL you will scan; an authorization server on another host needs its own proof.

name: verify_ownership
title: Verify ownership proof
